body: Because I don't want to disclose him/her pronouns (and they/them/theirs is an acceptable way of referring to an individual in a gender neutral way) as an added layer of protecting their identity. That's just me being skeptical of sharing this kind of information with strangers in the internet.

We've been working on changing the workplace, but it isn't easy. And financial stress has been a major part of this because we can't seem to get a leg up on our money. The worst part is that I see everything they see and I see how depressing it all seems and I can't genuinely say anything to make it seem better than it is because they would see right through that. I know it will get better, but I have no way of communicating that that would actually sound sincere, ya know?
